item.title: JavaScript File MIME Type Detection: Client-Side Inspection Methods
item.description:
“JavaScript File MIME Type Detection: Client-Side Inspection Methods”

How can a web application accurately ascertain the true MIME type of a file selected by a user via a client-side input element, especially when relying solely on the File.type property is unreliable due to potential spoofing via renaming?

While server-side verification remains the preferred security measure, robust client-side checks offer valuable immediate feedback to the user. Modern browsers offer the File API, which, when combined with binary data reading, allows for inspecting file headers—the so-called “magic numbers”—to verify authenticity.

item.title: JavaScript Methods for Client-Side Image Preview and Metadata Extraction
item.description:
“JavaScript Methods for Client-Side Image Preview and Metadata Extraction”

How can a developer implement robust client-side handling for multiple image file selections in a web application, specifically focusing on generating previews and extracting image properties like dimensions, file type, and size before actual server submission? What are the distinct JavaScript approaches available for achieving this functionality, particularly leveraging the HTML5 File API?

The challenge lies in accessing local file data within the browser environment to display previews or perform client-side validations, such as checking dimensions or format compliance. Several effective solutions exist using native browser APIs.
